_meta.description: Global functions (and a few global constants/static helpers) REMOVED at each Elgg major version, with their replacement. Used by PostMigrationVerifier::checkRemovedFunctions() to flag calls to functions that no longer exist at the migration target (the 'undefined symbol' class the shape-based completeness gate is blind to — bd elgg-migrate-abyju). Each target version's set is treated cumulatively: a function removed at 4.x is still removed at 6.x.
_meta.method: The 6.x set was verified empirically via Elgg\Application::loadCore() + function_exists() inside the real core container (not static grep, which is fooled by plugin-provided functions). 6.x set verified against Elgg 6.1.5 on 2026-06-03. The 3.x / 4.x / 5.x sets were reconstructed from this project's own migration history — .wolf/cerebrum.md Do-Not-Repeat, .wolf/buglog.json, and bd memories — where each removal produced a real 'Call to undefined function' fatal during a bodyology plugin migration.
_meta.detection_note: The gate matches each key as a CALL: `/(?<![\w>$:\\])(name)\s*\(/`. So bare global calls (name(...)) are caught; a global constant like ELGG_CACHE_PERSISTENT (no parens) is documented here for completeness but is NOT flagged by the call-shaped gate, and static/instance method forms (ElggFile::detectMimeType) are only caught in the unqualified-static form — see references/migration-failure-catalog.md for the precise per-class detection.

false_positives_excluded.elgg_ws_expose_function: provided by the web_services bundled plugin — not a core removal
false_positives_excluded.elgg_view_input: provided by the forms_api plugin (mod/forms_api/functions.php) as a BC shim — calls work wherever forms_api is active; migrating to elgg_view_field() is optional modernization, not a fatal-fix, so it is NOT listed as removed
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_comments: provided by a third-party counters plugin (lib/functions.php), not Elgg core/bundled; never a 7.x core removal
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_likes: provided by a third-party counters plugin (lib/functions.php), not an Elgg core/bundled global
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_friends: provided by a third-party counters plugin (lib/functions.php), not an Elgg core/bundled global
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_members: provided by a third-party counters plugin (lib/functions.php), not an Elgg core/bundled global

3.x.elgg_get_metastring_id: removed with the metastrings table in Elgg 3.0 — rework via QueryBuilder / the metadata API (bd elgg-migrate bug-022: group_sort/object_sort/user_sort built raw SQL on this)
3.x._elgg_entities_get_metastrings_options: private metastrings query API removed in 3.0 — use elgg_get_entities() QueryBuilder options

4.x.elgg_register_css: elgg_register_external_file('css', $name, $url) — or declare view_extensions in elgg-plugin.php
4.x.elgg_format_attributes: _elgg_services()->html_formatter->formatAttributes($attrs) — or build attributes manually with htmlspecialchars()
4.x.ElggFile::detectMimeType: mime_content_type($path) guarded by file_exists() — both the static ElggFile::detectMimeType($path) and instance $file->detectMimeType() forms were removed in 4.x
4.x.access_get_show_hidden_status: elgg_call(ELGG_SHOW_DISABLED_ENTITIES | ELGG_IGNORE_ACCESS, function () { ... }) — the save/restore access_get_show_hidden_status()/access_show_hidden_entities() pattern is gone

5.x.add_translation: return the array directly from the language file — Elgg 5.x's Translator include-loads the file and expects the returned array (drop the $english = [...]; add_translation('en', $english); wrapper)

6.x.elgg_pop_breadcrumb: breadcrumbs auto-managed; remove or use elgg_set_breadcrumbs([])
6.x.elgg_group_gatekeeper: elgg_group_gatekeeper() removed — use elgg_entity_gatekeeper() / group access checks
6.x._elgg_get_access_where_sql: private API removed — use QueryBuilder access clauses

7.x.elgg_geocode_location: removed — no core replacement; needs a geocoding service (plugin-specific)
7.x.ELGG_CACHE_PERSISTENT: removed cache-layer flag — the persistent cache layer was dropped in 7.x; use ELGG_CACHE_RUNTIME / ELGG_CACHE_FILESYSTEM (NOTE: a bare constant, not a call — documented here but not flagged by the call-shaped gate)
